v_product_estimates.description: By `year, age_group, product_code`, **plus `age_group = 'all'` rows**: `product_title`, `n_cases`, `est_visits = SUM(weight)`, `low_sample` (`n_cases < min_cases`), `is_placeholder`, `is_catch_all`, `title_unknown` (Rules 1, 2, 5). **Never sum across `age_group`, because `'all'` is included, and never sum across products**

v_case_products.description: `neiss_cases` ⨝ `neiss_case_products` ⟕ `product_codes`: one row per (case, distinct product). Adds `product_title` (with the untitled-code fallback label), `is_placeholder`, `is_catch_all`, `title_unknown`

neiss_cases.description: One row per ED case. Grain: `case_id`. Years: set in `config.yaml` (sizing in item 5).

columns.name: body_part
columns.notes: Codebook. 0 = Internal (a real value), 87 = not stated

v_recalls_for_product.description: `product_recall_xwalk` ⨝ `recalls` ⨝ `product_codes`, with `confidence` and `audited` exposed. The agent must state when `audited = false`

data_dictionary.description: `table_name, column_name, type, nullable, notes`, parsed from this file. Views get one row each, with `column_name = '*'`

neiss_case_products.description: Long form of the three product slots. Grain: (`case_id`, `product_code`).

columns.name: slot
columns.notes: 1-3, the first slot in which the code appears

columns.name: product_code
columns.notes: FK `product_codes`. Zeros dropped; deduplicated per case

neiss_codebook.description: From the data dictionary, sheet "2019 and beyond". Grain: (`variable`, `code`).

columns.name: is_unknown
columns.notes: True only for pure unknown/not-recorded codes

product_code_stability.description: Empirical presence of each code in the loaded years, from `build_neiss.py`. Grain: `product_code`.

columns.name: first_year
columns.notes: First loaded year with any case

columns.name: last_year
columns.notes: Last loaded year with any case

columns.name: present_all_years
columns.notes: True if present in every loaded year

columns.name: comparability_checked
columns.notes: NULL until the comparability tables are parsed

product_codes.description: From the January 2025 coding manual, Appendix H. 806 codes; covers every 2025 code.

columns.name: is_catch_all
columns.notes: Title matches other / not specified / not elsewhere classified

product_recall_xwalk.description: A **text-based** link from NEISS products to recalls. There is no NEISS code in the recall data (Rule 6).

columns.name: recall_id
columns.notes: FK `recalls`. NULL on the terms-only row

columns.name: search_terms
columns.notes: The exact terms used, e.g. `bunk bed; bunk beds`

columns.name: match_method
columns.notes: `text_search`, `sp_category_id` (recall CategoryID -> SP name -> NEISS title; older recalls only), or `manual`

columns.name: audited
columns.notes: True only after human review of the recall text

columns.name: notes
columns.notes: Why it matches, or why it is excluded

recall_products.description: Grain: (`recall_id`, `product_seq`). `CategoryID` / `Type` are stored where present (Rule 6). They are SaferProducts category ids, **not NEISS codes**.

columns.name: category_id
columns.notes: `CategoryID`. SP category id. NULL for all 2017-2025 recalls

recalls.description: Grain: `recall_id`. A response containing `RecallID = 0` or a `Title` starting with "Error retrieving" is the API's error pseudo-recall, and the **build fails**.

columns.name: search_text
columns.notes: Lowercased title + product names + category names + hazards + description, for search

safer_category_xwalk.description: SP category -> NEISS code **by exact normalized name**. Normalization: lowercase, with every run of non-alphanumeric characters replaced by one space, then trimmed. Grain: `sp_category_id`.

columns.name: sp_duplicate_name
columns.notes: True when another SP id has the same name

safer_codebook.description: Grain: (`lookup`, `id`). Covers ProductCategories, SeverityTypes, Locales, Sexes, SourceTypes, and RelationshipTypes.

safer_incidents.description: Grain: `incident_report_id`. 71,858 reports, 2011-03 to 2026-10. `/Date(ms)/` values are converted as UTC.

columns.name: incident_date
columns.notes: Can be years before the report date

columns.name: victim_sex_id
columns.notes: `safer_codebook` (Sexes): **1 = Female, 2 = Male**, 3 = Unknown. -1 (not defined in the lookup) -> NULL

columns.name: victim_age_group
columns.notes: Same bands as NEISS; `unknown` if NULL

v_recall_search.description: `recall_id, recall_date, title, hazards_text, search_text` for keyword search (`ILIKE`). If the DuckDB `fts` extension loads at build time, `build_db.py` also creates a BM25 index on `recalls.search_text`. Its availability in the Cloud Run image is **unverified**, so the agent must work with `ILIKE` alone
